defaults to 5,242,880 bytes ... defaults to 1,000 records ... A file above the effective byte limit produces a byte-limit result with zero user creations.

verdicts.missing: Empty and header-only files are specified, but no clause explicitly states that a single-data-row file is accepted and creates its one user.
